title: LuckRead D1-04 W07 Payment Method Revocation PostgreSQL Schema Slice

modifiedExistingTrigger.name: payment_provider_events_terminal_immutable
modifiedExistingTrigger.reason: Permit only mandate_active/mandate_revoked events previously marked RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED to be reset to RECEIVED with processed_at/outcome_code cleared; existing event identity/payload trigger keeps original payload hash immutable.

runtimeRevocationGate.predicate: NOT EXISTS payment_method_revocation_requests joined through the same saved_payment_methods identity with status <> COMPLETED

payment_method_revocation_requests.providerDeleteTimestamp: Once provider_method_deleted_at is set it cannot be changed; it is not proof that mandate webhooks have all been applied.
payment_method_revocation_requests.completionRule: COMPLETED requires provider_method_deleted_at and every mandate attached to the saved method to be REVOKED, FAILED or EXPIRED.
payment_method_revocation_requests.ownerRule: Insert requires exact provider/merchant/customer/payment_method_id match with one existing saved_payment_methods row.
payment_method_revocation_requests.relationship: The D1 source has a saved_payment_methods reference; PostgreSQL preserves the same owner binding using a source-semantic trigger and keeps D1-04 without foreign keys.
payment_method_revocation_requests.retention: Revocation request audit records are retained.

postgresMappings.integer: Map source INTEGER version to BIGINT.
postgresMappings.time: Map ISO-8601 TEXT created_at/updated_at/provider_method_deleted_at to TIMESTAMPTZ and compare as instants.
postgresMappings.idempotency: Preserve customer-scoped unique (customer_id,idempotency_key) and one revocation request per saved_payment_method_id.
postgresMappings.relationship: The source saved-method reference is checked against provider, merchant, customer and opaque payment_method_id in a trigger; no PostgreSQL foreign key is added.
postgresMappings.providerDelete: provider_method_deleted_at is immutable after first set; provider API deletion and signed mandate webhook finality remain separate facts.
postgresMappings.completion: A request can complete only after provider deletion is recorded and every linked mandate is terminal (REVOKED/FAILED/EXPIRED).
postgresMappings.eventReplay: Only an immutable first-receipt mandate_active/mandate_revoked event in RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED may be reset to RECEIVED with processed_at/outcome_code NULL. APPLIED and REJECTED receipts stay terminal; the existing payload/identity trigger prevents changing its SHA-256 or event identity.
postgresMappings.renewalGate: Existing W07 renewal runtime queries continue to reject a matching active mandate while any linked revocation request status is not COMPLETED. No new Worker or D1 binding is required.
postgresMappings.authority: W07 remains the sole D1-04 finance authority; D1-01 remains subscription entitlement authority.

requiredPositiveCases: revocation request is inserted only for an exact matching saved method/merchant/customer/provider/token identity
one customer can create a single idempotent revocation request for one saved method
REQUESTED can advance to PENDING_PROVIDER or RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED under one-step version CAS
provider_method_deleted_at can be recorded once and remains immutable
a request completes only after provider deletion and all mandates for the saved method are terminal
a RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED mandate_active/mandate_revoked provider receipt can be reopened as RECEIVED with processed_at/outcome_code cleared while its payload hash remains unchanged
existing renewal queries exclude a saved method while a linked revocation request is not COMPLETED
requiredNegativeCases: unknown saved method and mismatched provider/merchant/customer/payment_method_id are rejected
duplicate saved_payment_method_id and customer-scoped idempotency key are rejected
revocation request commercial identity cannot be rewritten
version must advance exactly one and updated_at must increase
provider deletion timestamp cannot be replaced or cleared after it is set
COMPLETED without provider deletion timestamp is rejected
COMPLETED while any linked mandate remains non-terminal is rejected
APPLIED and REJECTED provider receipts cannot be reopened
non-mandate or non-reconciliation provider receipts cannot be reopened
mandate receipt payload hash/identity remains immutable during exact replay
noRemoteOperations: no Worker deployment or binding change

nextGate: All seven W07 D1-04 source schema slices now have PostgreSQL 18.6 local rehearsal evidence. The D1-04 shared-ledger remote runner, remote Neon schema apply, business data import and production cutover remain separate, unauthorized gates.
